newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary 1996 prelim. GDP rises by 1.0 pct - KSH.
newsitem.headline: Hungary 1996 prelim. GDP rises by 1.0 pct - KSH.

text.p: Hungary's gross domestic product (GDP) rose by one percent in 1996, compared with 1.5 percent in 1995 according to preliminary figures released by the Central Statistical Office on Friday.
HUNGARY 1996 GDP Q4 Q3 Q2 Q1 1996

NOTE - The figures are preliminary. This was the fourth time that the KSH released preliminary quarterly GDP figures. It did not give absolute figures. The government target for 1996 GDP growth was maximum one percent. The 1996 GDP was forecast to amount to some 6600 billion forints ($1=164.92 forints). Hungary targets two to three percent GDP growth for 1997.
